title: VinePPO：步级 Monte-Carlo 回报账（树评分与差分优势 + 路径抽取聚合过滤 + 字符级优势分摊）
title_en: VinePPO: Step-Level Monte-Carlo Return Accounting (Tree Scoring & Differential Advantage + Path Extraction/Aggregation/Filtering + Character-Level Advantage Apportionment)
source_lines: tree_episode_generator.py TreeEpisodeUtils (compute_score/compute_advantage/extract_paths_from_tree) + convert_path_to_episode advantage 段 + path_aggregators.py + path_filters.py
description:
VinePPO 的核心主张：LLM 推理题上价值网难训（每个中间步都要求"从这里走下去最终对"的期望，COPRO 等逐步价值估计误差大），不如不要价值网——在每步分支处续采 k 条完整轨迹、用答案正确性当回报，把每步的 MC 回报均值当 value、advantage 做纯树形差分。官方 TreeEpisodeUtils + PathAggregator/PathFilter 全注册类（torch/Ray/多进程剥除，账目全入参），六入口复刻：score（compute_score）——叶判定是 "answer" in node（不是无 children），预测答案从 node["answer"] 经 pred_map 提取（node 自带 "pred" 字段完全不参与），None→0、否则 int(pred==gold)，is_correct_answer 冗余写同值，内部节点 score=子 score 均值、无子 0；advantage（compute_advantage）——child.advantage=child.score−parent.score 的树形差分（无自底向上 bias 传播），叶直接 return 不赋值、root 无 advantage；paths（extract_paths_from_tree）——输入树先 deepcopy，importance_weight=branch_factor**(max_depth−depth) 但达 max_depth 的节点写 1，repeat_early_stopped_paths 时**所有浅于 max_depth 的叶路径**（不只早停叶）按 importance_weight 份 extend，遍历顺手逐节点 pop("children")，最后 json round-trip（元组变列表）；aggregate——none 原样返回，unique 用 json.dumps(sort_keys=True) 进 set 去重再还原（set 无序只能比集合），top_k_percent 排序键是各节点 advantage.get("advantage",0)（根无 advantage 记 0）的 mean/sum、sorted reverse=True 稳定、num=int(len*p)、keep_at_least_one 时 max(num,1)，max_k_paths 在 len<=k 时原样返回否则 random.Random(42).sample；filter——successful 看末节点 is_correct_answer（无 "answer"→False），non_zero_score 看 **node_chain[1]（第一步）**而非末节点，non_zero/zero_last_step_score 与 non_zero_last_step_advantage 看末节点；advantage_split（convert_path_to_episode 的字符级分摊段）——字符账 ones(len(response_text))*-777 哨兵起底，响应文本按首节点 "
"+text+（多节点再加 "
"）/中间节点 text+"
"/末节点 text 拼接逐段广播赋值（恰好填满时哨兵不残留、response_text 更长则尾部留 -777），token 账 ones(len(input_ids))*-999 哨兵起底、token advantage=advantage_char[offset_mapping[i][0]]（多字符 token 只取起始字符），assert tokens[0]=="▁"，清理账 = advantage_token[1:] 与 input_ids.reshape(-1)[1:]（都剥首位 "▁"）。
description_en:
VinePPO's core claim: value networks are hard to train on LLM reasoning (every intermediate step demands the expectation "will we end up correct from here"; per-step value estimates like COPRO are noisy), so drop the value network entirely — at each step branch, continue-sampling k full rollouts, use answer correctness as the reward, take each step's MC return mean as the value, and compute advantages as a pure tree-shaped differencing. This problem replicates the official TreeEpisodeUtils plus all PathAggregator/PathFilter registered classes (torch/Ray/multiprocessing stripped, accounting fully parameterized) via six solve entries: score — leaf detection is `"answer" in node` (not absence of children); the predicted answer is extracted from node["answer"] via pred_map (the node's own "pred" field plays no part); None→0, else int(pred==gold); is_correct_answer redundantly mirrors score; internal nodes take the mean of child scores (0 if childless). advantage — child.advantage = child.score − parent.score, a pure tree differencing (no bottom-up bias propagation); leaves return without assignment; root gets none. paths — the input tree is deep-copied first; importance_weight = branch_factor**(max_depth−depth) but nodes at max_depth get 1; with repeat_early_stopped_paths every leaf shallower than max_depth (not just early-stopped ones) is extended importance_weight times; children are popped per-node during traversal; a final json round-trip normalizes (tuples become lists). aggregate — none returns the list as-is; unique dedupes via a set of json.dumps(p, sort_keys=True) then restores (set order is unreproducible — compare as sets); top_k_percent sorts by each path's mean/sum of node.get("advantage", 0) (roots count as 0), sorted reverse=True stable, num=int(len*p), max(num,1) when keep_at_least_one; max_k_paths returns paths as-is when len<=k, else random.Random(42).sample. filter — successful reads the last node's is_correct_answer (False if no "answer"); non_zero_score reads **node_chain[1] (the first step)**, not the last node; the last-step score/advantage variants read the final node. advantage_split (the character-level apportionment inside convert_path_to_episode) — char ledger starts from ones(len(response_text))*-777 sentinels; the response text is the concat of first node "
"+text+ ("
" again if multi-node) / middle nodes text+"
" / last node text, assigned per-segment by broadcast (sentinels vanish when the concat fills response_text exactly; a longer response_text leaves -777 tails); token ledger starts from ones(len(input_ids))*-999 with token advantage = advantage_char[offset_mapping[i][0]] (multi-char tokens take only their start char); asserts tokens[0]=="▁"; cleanup slices [1:] off advantage_token and input_ids.reshape(-1)[1:] (both stripping the leading "▁").
notes: 官方账的关键细节（沙箱实测钉死）：(1) score 的 pred 提取只看 node["answer"]——树里自带的 "pred" 字段是死数据，置 None 不影响 score（有专门用例钉）；Shortcut 叶 answer="The answer is 4." 不在 pred_map → 提取 None → score 0，尽管其 pred 字段是 "4"。(2) repeat_early_stopped_paths 的"早停"名不副实：所有浅于 max_depth 的叶（含正常完成但浅的 2a 叶）都按 importance_weight 重复——三层树 bf=2 md=3 时输出 [3,3,4,2,2,2,2]（2a 重复 2 份、shortcut 重复 4 份）。(3) top_k_percent 的 advantage 序列含根节点（get("advantage",0) 记 0），mean 会把根算进分母。(4) unique 的输出顺序是 set 序，跨进程不可复现（PYTHONHASHSEED），测试只能比集合。(5) non_zero_score 取 node_chain[1]——官方假设链至少 [root, 一步]。(6) 字符级 -777 / token 级 -999 双哨兵：response_text 比 node 拼接长时尾部 -777 残留并经 offset 传导进 token 账；多字符 token 只取 offset_mapping[i][0] 起始字符的 advantage（跨 0.5/1.0 边界的 token 整个归边界前段）。(7) advantage 分摊段与 tokenizer 的耦合已入参化：input_ids/offset_mapping/tokens 显式传入，StubEnc 镜像 HF BatchEncoding 表面（tokens()[0]=="▁" 断言保留）。与 to-gae / to-ppo-value-clip 划界：这里没有可学习价值网与 TD/λ 折扣——value 就是 MC 回报均值，账目是纯树遍历 + 树形差分。
notes_en: Key official details (pinned by sandbox runs): (1) score's pred extraction reads only node["answer"] — the tree's own "pred" field is dead data; setting it to None does not change the score (a dedicated case pins this); the Shortcut leaf's answer "The answer is 4." is absent from pred_map → extracted None → score 0, despite its "pred": "4". (2) repeat_early_stopped_paths is a misnomer: every leaf shallower than max_depth (including the normally-completed shallow 2a leaf) repeats importance_weight times — for the 3-level tree with bf=2 md=3 the output is [3,3,4,2,2,2,2] (2a twice, shortcut 4x). (3) top_k_percent's advantage sequence includes the root (get("advantage",0) counts as 0), so mean divides by a denominator containing it. (4) unique's output order is set order, unreproducible across processes (PYTHONHASHSEED); tests must compare as sets. (5) non_zero_score reads node_chain[1] — the code assumes chains of at least [root, one step]. (6) Dual sentinels -777 (char) / -999 (token): a response_text longer than the node concat leaves -777 tails that propagate into the token ledger via offsets; multi-char tokens take only advantage_char[offset_mapping[i][0]] (a token straddling the 0.5/1.0 boundary belongs entirely to the pre-boundary segment). (7) The apportionment segment's tokenizer coupling is parameterized: input_ids/offset_mapping/tokens are explicit inputs; StubEnc mirrors the HF BatchEncoding surface (the tokens()[0]=="▁" assert is kept). Boundary vs to-gae / to-ppo-value-clip: no learnable value network and no TD/λ discount here — the value is the MC return mean itself; the accounting is pure tree traversal plus tree-shaped differencing.
